visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and a clean white T-shirt faces the camera in a bright, modern indoor setting. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically while holding a small beige cosmetic sponge. Behind him is a minimalist white wall with a decorative black sculpture on a shelf. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the man's hands holding two Elizabeth Arden products: a round glass jar of foundation and a square gold-toned powder compact. Text overlays appear in the center identifying the products in Chinese. (3) He uses a cotton swab to apply a dollop of foundation onto his hand, spreading the thick, mousse-like texture to demonstrate its consistency. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting his smooth skin. (4) The man applies the foundation directly to his cheek with his fingers, then blends it in with a white sponge while looking into a handheld mirror. Close-up shots focus on the right side of his face showing improved skin tone. (5) He demonstrates the coverage of the powder compact by drawing two thick black lines on his forearm and then dabbing the powder over them with a brush. One line becomes significantly obscured, showing high opacity. (6) In the final phase, he presents his full face with completed makeup, looking polished and radiant. He holds both products up to the camera again, smiling broadly with his hands framing his face.
